<objective>
Extract `attachment-preview`'s heavy Canvas drawing primitives AND its coordinate hit-testing into one `AttachmentCanvasRendererService` (D-04: render + hit-test MUST stay together because both use the same original-image pixel-space `attachmentPointPositions` map — splitting them would duplicate that math). Per RESEARCH.md Pitfall 4 / Open Question 2, this is implemented as an injectable service called imperatively by the preview shell, NOT a child component with mirrored `@Input()`s — this avoids duplicating the shell's `ngOnChanges` change-list.

Critical D-05 constraint: the service holds NO selection or hover state. `selectedAttachmentPointId`/`hoveredAttachmentId`/`hoveredPointId` stay parent-owned and are passed INTO the render call as parameters. The service is a stateless-per-call renderer plus a position-map/geometry helper.

This plan creates the service only; wiring the thinned `attachment-preview` shell to it is Plan 05 (Wave 3). Both are behavior-preserving — the drawing output and hit-detection radii must match today exactly.

Purpose: Shrink the 856-line `attachment-preview.component.ts` below ~400 lines by relocating ~600 lines of `render*`/hit-test logic (DECOMP-03), leaving the shell as a Canvas host + layout/lifecycle owner.
Output: `src/app/services/attachment-canvas-renderer.service.ts` + spec.
</objective>

  <behavior>
    - `hitTest(x,y,positions)` returns the point id whose original-pixel position is within the click-detection radius of (x,y), and null when no point is within range.
    - `hoverTest(x,y,positions)` returns the hovered point id under the same geometry.
    - `render(params)` with a model + one attachment point populates `attachmentPointPositions` with that point's id mapped to a numeric `{x,y}`.
    - Overlay position math produces no double-scaling (mirror preview spec lines 55-88 at the service boundary).
  </behavior>
